_comment: Edit this in Snuggery: the app's ⋯ menu → App Files. Each row is a name and how many hours the appliance runs for; the app finds the cheapest run of that length in each day's prices. Fractions are fine (1.5 is ninety minutes). Editing it on the phone changes the app at once; the ask table catches up the next time the refresh job runs, so change it in the repository too if you want both to agree.
